name: 托福词汇
description: 托福考试核心词汇（含音标、释义、短语、例句）

words.definition: [adv] 回原处; [n] 背,后面; [adj] 后面的
words.phrases: go back → 回去；追溯 | back in → [体育]后内刃 | back of → 在…后面；在…背后
words.example: a T-shirt with a picture of a snake on the back
words.exampleTranslation: 后背印了一条蛇的T恤衫

words.definition: [adj] 重要的,意义重大的; [adj] 有重大意义的， 重要的， 显著的； 意味深长的
words.phrases: significant difference → 显著性差异 | significant change → 显著变化；有效变化量 | statistically significant → 统计上显著的
words.example: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
words.exampleTranslation: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

words.phrases: communication skill → 沟通技巧；传播技能 | skill in → 技能；对…熟练 | skill training → 技能训练；技巧训练
words.example: Reading and writing are two different skills.
words.exampleTranslation: 阅读和写作是两种不同的技能。

words.definition: [adj] 公共的,公开的; [n] 公众
words.phrases: in public → adv. 公开地，当众 | public health → n. 公共卫生；公共卫生设施 | public security → 公共安全
words.example: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (= helpful or useful to ordinary people ) .
words.exampleTranslation: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

words.phrases: going on → 进行，发生 | go home → 回家 | let go → 放开；释放；发射
words.example: The plate went crashing to the floor.
words.exampleTranslation: 盘子哗啦一声掉在地板上。

words.phrases: big fish → 大鱼；重要人物 | fish for → 摸索；寻找 | fish oil → 鱼油，鱼肝油
words.example: Over 1,500 different species of fish inhabit the waters around the reef.
words.exampleTranslation: 那片礁石周围的水域生活着1,500多种不同的鱼类。

words.phrases: set up → v. 建立；装配；开业；竖立 | a set of → 一套；一组；一副 | set out → 出发；开始；陈述；陈列
words.example: The set (x, y) has two members.
words.exampleTranslation: （x, y）这个集里有两个项。

words.example: I’ve only met her once.
words.exampleTranslation: 我只见过她一面。

words.phrases: on the table → 在桌面上；公开地 | under the table → 酒醉；秘密地 | table tennis → 乒乓球；桌球
words.example: The food was served on long tables.
words.exampleTranslation: 食物放在长餐桌上供应。

words.phrases: demand of → v. 要求；向…索取 | demand for → 对…的需求 | market demand → 市场需求
words.example: Angry demonstrators demanded the resignation of two senior officials.
words.exampleTranslation: 愤怒的示威者要求两名高级官员辞职。

words.phrases: every day → 每天；每个白天 | one day → （将来）有一天；总有一天；（过去）某一天 | all day → 整天
words.example: We spent three days in Paris.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们在巴黎度过了三天。

words.definition: [n] 南部; [adj] 南方的; [adv] 在南方
words.phrases: south korea → 南韩 | south of → 在…之南 | in the south → 在南方
words.example: Which way is south?
words.exampleTranslation: 哪面是南？

words.phrases: almost all → 几乎处处
words.example: Have you almost finished?
words.exampleTranslation: 你差不多完成了吗？

words.definition: [adj] 当地的,局部的; [n] 当地人
words.phrases: local government → 地方政府；[总称]地方政府官员（或工作人员） | local area network → n. 局域网 | local culture → 本土文化；地方文化
words.example: We asked one of the locals to recommend a restaurant.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们请一位当地人推荐一家餐馆。

words.phrases: open up → 打开；开发；开始；展示，揭露 | in the open → 在户外；在野外 | open the door → 开门
words.example: He threw the door open and ran down the stairs.
words.exampleTranslation: 他猛地打开门，往楼下跑去。

words.definition: [v] (掩)盖,包括,报道; [n] 盖子,封面
words.phrases: from cover to cover → 从头至尾 | under cover → 隐藏着；秘密地 | cover up → 掩盖，盖住
words.example: a course covering business law
words.exampleTranslation: 一门包括商业法的课程

words.phrases: for the purpose → 为某目的 | for the purpose of → 为了…目的 | on purpose → 有目的地，故意地
words.example: Nick had no particular purpose in mind when he started.
words.exampleTranslation: 尼克开始的时候头脑中并没有明确的目标。

words.definition: [v] 到达,伸出,达成; [n] 范围
words.phrases: reach out → vt. 伸出 | reach for → 伸手去拿 | reach an agreement → 达成协议；取得一致意见，达成共识
words.example: Chelsea could reach the final of the European Cup.
words.exampleTranslation: 切尔西队会进入欧洲杯决赛。

words.definition: [adj] 不同的,多样的,多方面的
words.phrases: in various ways → 以不同的方式 | various styles → 各种款式；款式齐全；款式多样 | various people → 各行各业的人；许多人
words.example: The jacket is available in various colours.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种夹克有好多种颜色可选。

words.phrases: of late → adv. 最近；近来 | late for → 迟到；来不及… | late stage → 末期；后期；晚期
words.example: Sorry I’m late – I overslept.
words.exampleTranslation: 对不起，来晚了

words.definition: [adv] 将来(或过去)某个时候; [adj] 以前的
words.example: The sales figures won't be released until sometime next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 销售数据要到下个月的某个时候才会公布。

words.definition: [n] 功能,职务; [v] 运行,起作用; [v] 运行； 起作用
words.phrases: and function → [计]与酌 | objective function → 目标函数 | system function → 系统功能；系统函数
words.example: The nervous system regulates our bodily functions (= eating, breathing, going to the toilet etc ) .
words.exampleTranslation: 神经系统控制着我们身体的功能。

words.phrases: will be able to → 将能够 | be able to do → 能够做 | be able to take → 经受得住某事(指困难、痛苦的事)
words.example: one of my more able students
words.exampleTranslation: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

words.phrases: allow for → 考虑到，虑及 | allow of → 容许
words.example: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
words.exampleTranslation: 泳池内禁止跳水。

words.definition: [n] 中部,中间; [adj] 中部的,中间的
words.phrases: in the middle → 在中间；在中部 | in the middle of → 在…中间 | middle school → n. 中学
words.example: driving in the middle lane of the motorway
words.exampleTranslation: 在高速公路的中间车道上行驶

words.phrases: at home → 在家；在国内；熟悉 | home and abroad → 国内外，海内外 | at home and abroad → 国内外
words.example: They have a beautiful home in California.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们在加州有个美丽的家。

words.phrases: european union → 欧洲联盟，欧盟 | european countries → 欧洲国家 | european commission → 欧洲委员会

words.exampleTranslation: 欧洲的语言

words.phrases: reason for → 原因，理由 | main reason → 主要原因 | for this reason → 为此；由于这个原因
words.example: She has reason to feel guilty.
words.exampleTranslation: 她有理由感到内疚。

words.phrases: on the rise → 在增加；在上涨 | give rise to → 使发生，引起 | temperature rise → 温升；温度上升
words.example: The police seem unable to cope with the rising tide of (= large increase in ) car crime.
words.exampleTranslation: 面对日益增多的汽车罪案，警方似乎无能为力。

words.phrases: party member → 党员 | family member → 家庭成员；家族成员 | staff member → 职员
words.example: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
words.exampleTranslation: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

words.phrases: go toward → 朝...方向走去 | make toward → 向…延伸；向…前进
white house → n. 白宫（美国政府的行政机关，美国总统官邸） | in the house → 在房子里；在屋子里 | publishing house → 出版公司，出版社
words.example: The president will address both houses of Congress.
words.exampleTranslation: 总统将向参众两院发表讲话。

words.definition: [n] 特性,特征; [adj] 特有的,典型的; [adj] 特有的； 典型的
words.phrases: characteristic of → 特有的；表示…特性的 | dynamic characteristic → 动态特性；负载特性曲线 | characteristic curve → 特性曲线；特征曲线
words.example: the highly characteristic (= very typical ) flint walls of the local houses
words.exampleTranslation: 当地房子非常有特色的燧石墙

words.definition: [adj] 刚过去的,最后的; [adv] 最后; [v] 持续
words.phrases: at last → 最后；终于 | last year → 去年 | last week → 上周，上星期
words.example: I didn’t read the last chapter of the book.
words.exampleTranslation: 我没有看这本书的最后一章。

words.phrases: fault location → 故障定位 | strategic location → 战略位置；关键部分 | on location → 出外景；现场拍摄

words.exampleTranslation: 他的公寓地段很好。

words.exampleTranslation: 我昨天没能去买东西，所以今天我必须去。

words.phrases: traditional culture → 传统文化 | corporate culture → 企业文化，公司文化 | enterprise culture → 企业文化

words.exampleTranslation: 我们在家说丹麦语，这样男孩子们就不会脱离他们的语言和文化。

words.definition: [n] 婴儿; [adj] 婴儿的； 初期的; [n] 婴儿，幼儿

words.exampleTranslation: 幼儿的皮肤非常敏感。

words.definition: [adj] 左边的; [adv] 向左; [n] 左边

words.exampleTranslation: 她伸出左手。

words.exampleTranslation: 欧文最新的书

words.phrases: western europe → 西欧 | eastern europe → 东欧 | continental europe → 欧洲大陆

words.exampleTranslation: 东欧

words.phrases: family planning → n. 计划生育 | family member → 家庭成员；家族成员 | family life → 家庭生活

words.exampleTranslation: 你认识隔壁那家人吗？

words.definition: [n] 位置,地点; [v] 使位于,设置

words.exampleTranslation: 考古现场

words.phrases: politically incorrect → 政治上不正确的；不合时宜的

words.exampleTranslation: 你给我们的信息不准确。

words.definition: [n] 财产,所有物; [n] 财产， 所有物； 所有权； 房产， 地产； 特性

words.exampleTranslation: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

words.definition: [n] 大气,空气,气氛; [n] 大气， 大气层； 空气； 气氛， 氛围

words.exampleTranslation: 教师们别无选择，只能采取措施来保护自己。

words.exampleTranslation: 一年里心脏病发作了两次，可是那也没让他把烟戒掉。

words.example: He was a big strong man.
words.exampleTranslation: 他高大健壮。

words.definition: [a&ad] 清晰的(地); [v] 清除; [v] 变清澈

words.definition: [v] 沉淀,存放,堆积; [n] 存款,堆积物; [v] 沉淀；堆积；储蓄；

words.phrases: pacific ocean → n. 太平洋 | asia pacific → 亚太地区；亚太区 | pacific coast → 太平洋海岸

words.exampleTranslation: ...波纳佩的太平洋小岛。

words.definition: [adj] 可利用的,可得到的,有空的; [adj] 可得到的， 可找到的； 有空的

words.exampleTranslation: 高级用户可直接浏览主数据文档。

words.phrases: foreign language → n. 外语；外文 | english language → 英文；英语语言学 | chinese language → 汉语

words.exampleTranslation: 保罗在大多数问题上观点激烈。

words.phrases: in deep → —深陷其中，深深卷入(尤指麻烦) | deep in → 深陷(于)，专心致力(于)，埋头(于)；沉湎于…中，全神贯注的 | deep water → 深层水，深水

words.definition: [adj] 绿色的,生的; [v] 使…变绿

words.phrases: in charge → 负责，主管；在…看管下 | in charge of → 负责；主管 | charge of → 负责；管理
